messages:
emma: Customer FinLedger legal is holding sign-off. They want a firm throughput guarantee for pilot -> prod. We told them 'sustained 600 rps' with p95 < 200ms for chat completions, but security paused on KMS/data residency Qs and finance wants committed vs burst pricing examples. Need presales + ops input.

liam: Quick sizing take — for sustained 600 rps with p95 ~200ms we should plan 2x A100-80GB-equivalent GPUs in Dedicated mode + 1 hot standby for AZ failover and maintenance windows. If they run a 7B quantized model this is reasonable; 13B will likely need 3 nodes or higher batch tuning. :thinking_face: 

ada: Re: security questionnaire — we can offer Redwood Private in their VPC with customer-managed KMS. Audit logs are exportable and we provide per-request traces and token-level cost/latency breakdown. HSM attestation: we support integrating with customer HSM/KMS; will include standard wording for attestations.

emma: Can we give them an example autoscale policy and explain fallback behavior when GPU capacity maxes out? They want details in the SOW.

liam: Sample autoscale policy (shareable):
```
autoscale:
  target_util: 0.65
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 6
  prewarm: true
  burst_credit: 1000
  fallback_models: [ "gptj-6b-q", "gptj-3b-quant" ]
```
Notes: prewarm keeps N warm workers to avoid cold-start latency; burst_credit is a pool of temporary GPU minutes; fallback_models are auto-routed cheaper variants when latency or queue depth crosses thresholds.

devon: Ops checklist — enable prefix/KV caching for repeated system prompts (saves ~25-35% GPU work), set request queue depth and circuit-breaker thresholds (recommend circuit at 500ms to fail fast and trigger fallback), and make sure health checks include KV cache hit ratio.

mia-salesbot: @emma created follow-up Confluence page: https://redwood.confluence/finledger/scope-210 (contains initial sizing and security attachments).

ada: Pricing sketch for quoting: Dedicated commit (2x A100-equivalent) ~ "$XXk/mo" (ballpark) with autoscale enabled; burst capacity billed on usage beyond commit. Recommend 12mo commit to lower unit cost. I'll attach a committed-vs-burst TCO sheet to the quote.

liam: For POC ops pattern — run hybrid traffic: 80% route to dedicated pool, 20% to hosted fallback. Instrument eval metrics and collect latency regressions on the cheaper variants. If latency > threshold, fallback to smaller batch sizes or cheaper model and tag events for QA.

emma: Security/legal require the completed questionnaire before exec approval. I attached our draft answers; need confirmation on HSM statement. @ada can you add KMS rotation and SOC2 wording?

ada: Added text for legal: "Customer-managed KMS allowed; key rotation policies are honored; audit logs exportable to customer S3/VPC endpoints; SOC2 Type II attestation available upon request." Sent to legal for review.

devon: Emergency runbook command (ops):
`redwood scale set --pool finledger-dedicated --replicas 4 --force-prewarm`
Use only with SRE approval.

emma: Next steps: liam to finalize sizing diagram and perf numbers, ada to finalize security blurb, finance to produce committed vs burst TCO spreadsheet. Owner: emma. ETA: EOD tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

liam: I'll attach perf logs from a similar deal (500 rps sustained on 2x A100-equivalent with 7B quant) and a microbench summary.

mia-salesbot: Deal stage updated to "presales - awaiting security" by emma

emma: Thanks all — I'll sync with customer 10:30am PT tomorrow and loop legal if they ask for extra HSM evidence.
